name: Jennifer Thompson
office: Pasadena Area Community College District, Governing Board Member, Trustee Area No. 5

items.text: Jennifer Thompson is a media and communications consultant running for the Pasadena Area Community College District, Trustee Area 5. In a candidate questionnaire, she said her two main priorities are increasing access and enrollment through stronger community connections and investing in the district's aging infrastructure.
